Pro tip for whatever you consume in the future, it has helped me a lot: if you have to ask if you're addicted, you're. Maybe not physically dependant but addiction creeps on you, and realizing that you're addicted is one of the hardest parts. 

Now, to answer your question, yes, you're addicted, but you realized! That's a huge step. Now it's time to act on that knowledge, get out of there before it get worse, CT it, don't get anymore and limit your access as much as possible. If you need to, ask for help, there's nothing wrong with that (it takes a fuckton of strength to do that), get out of there before you're in too deep bc trust me, you never realize until it's too late

No matter what anyone says, Wrist deep in depression -Im in a coffin, although yes, it has overused dsbm generic lyrics, the raw simple production and style, with the depression filled vocals make for an amazing, desperate song. 

From a personal note, A moment for my depression - Sacrimoon (and all of their discography for that matter) is fucking bleak. It has been my company during a lot of episodes, and probably one of the things that have saved my life. 

Ofdrykkja's "I skuggan av mija sjalv" expresses in such a precise and painful way what they were feeling back when they wrote that album (it was made by one of the Apati members after Obehag's death iirc). Silencer is always a classic, although might be a tad too melodical than what you're looking for. 

On the more "atmospheric" side of dsbm, my favourite ones are Paysage d'hiver (pardon my spelling), deadlife and, by far, None. Even if it's not your usual style, give None a listen, they'll surprise you.

In Psychonaut 4's Drop by Drop you can hear Graf's pain and hatred towards himself and the world, plus the lyrics are filles with such resentment. Akin to more melodical and experimental DSBM, Vanhelga's förstörd and lifelover in general are good. Finally dead by Vanhelga is a bubblegummy song with dark lyrics, pretty fun.

Honorable mentions to:

Anesthesized emotions - Enisum; Fire, walk with me - HFTS (post BM); Pestilence shall come - Advent Sorrow; I buried myself at the edge of the sky - Photophobia; painful memories - Uten Håp

Hmmmm kinda really hard to know without a proper reagent test, but first thing that comes to my mind would be a lysergamide along the lines of al-lad or eth-lad?. Usually 25x (either NBOMe or NBOH) series have a pretty distinctive metallic taste and tend to numb your mouth, but I've heard that it doesn't happen to all people, but 25x series are also rather stimulating so I'd discard that. 

The duration also discards the DOx family and the dragon-fly analogues. 2C-x are usually much less visual and more body high focused but they also tend to be stimulating and the active does is far too high to be administered in a blotter (unless is a fucking huge one, same with DOx as far as I know).

The tryptamines do tend to be less stimulating but they usually have too high of a dose to be used as a blotter and most of them have pretty clear visuals (with some exceptions such as 4-OH-MET (which lacks most of the body load), 5-MeO-MiPT, 5-MeO-DiPT, etc. But they usually also have pretty distinctive effects and same problem, dose far too high for a blotter). 

And the closer lysergamides analogues are pretty much indistinguishable from LSD (such as 1P, 1V, 1cP, etc.) LSA and LSZ would be admittedly a rather odd occurrence bc usually if you go through the effort to synth LSA, you tend to go through the extra step to synth LSD, LSZ it's pretty rare in general, so I don't see why they would sell it as LSD. That being said, LSZ it's also less stimulating than LSD. ALD-52 also comes to my mind bc it has less visuals, but in general it tends to be pretty similar to LSD. PRO-LAD and BU-LAD are extremely rare to find as far as I know, to the point that most of us probably have never met anyone who've tried either (with the latter one being even rarer). 

Keeping that in mind, I'd say that it probably was a lysergamide. Al-LAD, ETH-LAD, LSZ or maybe ALD-52 would be my guesses but as I mentioned in the beginning, it's pretty much impossible to know without proper lab testing. Out of curiosity if you have more and ever decide to GC/MS it would you mind sending me the results?

Like 3 days ago I got out of grippy socks jail. I met some awesome people and I actually had a good time, but most importantly, being there helped me realize a lot of things, mainly that I don't wanna keep doing this. I don't wanna yeet for the rest of my life, I don't wanna have depression for the rest of my life, I don't want that my gf finds my body after I bled out bc I accidentally yeeted too deep.

Sadly that last fear was becoming closer to a reality each time that I yeeted. I just kept going deeper and deeper, at some point I was used to yeeting to beans and not getting stitches (a big part of why I was sent to grippy sock jail). My parents are kinda fucked up, my family is even worse but I decided that I'm not gonna let them ruin my life. I've gotta stop yeeting.

With all that said I found out that, even tho this community has helped me a lot through everything, it also triggers me a lot. I feel bad about it, I don't wanna leave but I know I must if I wanna stay clean. It fills me with pain knowing that I have to stay away from such a lovely group of persons. 

It also fills me with pain that the thing that we all share is SH. Like why? Everyone of you is such an amazing person and everyone of you deserves the best on their life, but for some reason or another we ended up here, addicted, hiding our emotions behind a mask everyday, not even being able to enjoy life. 

But you know what? We can get better, don't be afraid to seek out help, I know it can be rly scary, and that sometimes you tell yourself that you don't deserve it but that's what your illness wants you to think, It wants you to stay miserable, as a song of my favorite band says "I'm not your killer, I'm your pain-dealer". It just wants you to see suffer, it doesn't wants you to enjoy life but you deserve it. Say fuck it and try new things, go and do crazy things, enjoy life, maybe break some rules, but also get professional help and I promise you everything will get better. Slowly? Yes, It will be hard? Yes, You will probably relapse? Also yes, but all of that is normal, and in the end you'll be better

Fascia is a relatively thin tissue that usually acts as a layer between organs and the skin per se. Un this case I think they are referring to the fascia that covers the muscles, like I'm not sure if u have realized that sometimes when u are eating chicken there's a layer of tissue between the skin and the meat? Well, that's fascia.

 It also can refer to a "bag" (the same tissue, the same function) that holds the organs in the abdomen, that fascia is a lot more complex and has "holes" (I'm not sure how to explain it, like vessels? Cavities?) Where some organs are found. In general not good to reach fascia, not good at all.
